hints.jpeg: Best for photos. No transparency: transparent areas become white.
hints.png: Lossless with transparency. Best for screenshots and logos.
hints.webp: Lossless with transparency, usually smaller than PNG.
hints.gif: Up to 256 colours. Animations keep only the first frame.
hints.tiff: Lossless, used for printing and scanning.
hints.ico: Windows icon. Images larger than 256 px are scaled down.

quality.label: Quality
quality.help: Lower values give smaller files with more loss of detail. 85 to 92 is a good balance.

convert.metadataNote: The photo orientation is applied and the colour profile is kept. Data such as location and camera is not copied.

help.fit: keeps the proportions inside the width and height

crop.sameArea: The same area is cropped from every image.

compress.qualityHelp: Used for JPEG. Lower values give smaller files.
compress.help: PNG uses the strongest lossless compression. If the result is not smaller than the original, the original is kept.

strip.help: Removes location (GPS), camera model, dates, comments and thumbnails without recompressing the image. Orientation and colour profile are kept.

merge.matchSize: Match sizes (shrinks the larger ones, never enlarges)
merge.order: Images follow the order of the list. Use the arrows to reorder.

toPdf.help: One image per page, in list order. JPEG photos keep their full quality; location and camera data are not copied.

ocr.label: OCR

unavailable.tooMany: At most {max} files at a time.

pages.label: Pages
pages.help: Numbers or ranges separated by commas. A backwards range (9-7) reverses the order.
pages.invalid: "{part}" is not a valid page or range.
pages.pastEnd: Page {page} does not exist (pages in the file: {count}).

split.label: How to split
split.rangesHelp: Each range becomes a file. E.g. 1-3, 4-10, 11
split.invalidEvery: Enter a whole number of pages, from 1.

selectPages.label: Pages, in the desired order
selectPages.help: E.g. "3, 1-2" puts page 3 first. "5-1" reverses the first five. Pages not listed are removed.

toImages.dpiHelp: 150 is good for screens; 300 for printing. High values make large files.
toImages.invalidDpi: The resolution must be a whole number from {min} to {max}.

protect.ownerHelp: Needed for restrictions: whoever has this password can lift them. It must differ from the password to open.
protect.help: Uses AES-256 encryption. Keep the password: without it the file cannot be opened. Most readers honour the restrictions, but not all.
protect.tooLong: The password is longer than {max} bytes.
protect.ownerRequired: To use restrictions, enter the owner password.
protect.ownerSame: The owner password must differ from the password to open.

unlock.help: Leave it empty if the file opens without a password and only has restrictions.

compress.label: Level

hints.standard: Reorganises and recompresses the file without changing its content. Helps most with PDFs made by older programs.
hints.strong: Downsamples images to about 150 DPI with Ghostscript. Good for e-mail; not recommended for printing.

compress.installGhostscript: Strong compression needs Ghostscript, which was not found. See the Tools screen.

ocr.help: Adds an invisible text layer over the pages without changing how they look. It may take a few seconds per page.

hints.docx: Text becomes text boxes placed as in the PDF. Good for small fixes; the layout may change. Scanned PDFs need OCR first.
hints.odt: Text becomes text boxes placed as in the PDF. Good for small fixes; the layout may change. Scanned PDFs need OCR first.

about.description: Converts and edits files on your computer: images, PDF, video, audio, documents, spreadsheets, presentations, subtitles, ebooks and archives.
about.privacy: No file leaves your computer. The app makes no network requests and has no telemetry, usage analytics or automatic updates.

ai.title: Notice about AI use
ai.text: This project was developed with the help of artificial intelligence tools. The code may contain bugs, security flaws or unexpected behavior. Review the code before using it with important files and keep backups of your data. The software is provided without warranty, under the GPL-3.0 license.

extractAudio.help: Only the first audio track is saved. "Original" keeps the sound exactly as it is.

embedSubtitle.help: Video and audio are copied without re-encoding. MP4 and MOV keep the subtitle as plain text (no styles); MKV keeps SRT, VTT and ASS as they are; AVI and older formats become MKV.

hints.pdf: Uses LibreOffice. Markdown and HTML go through Pandoc first.
hints.docx: Word documents, ODT, RTF and text use LibreOffice; Markdown and HTML use Pandoc. Only images in the file's folder (or subfolders) are included; images from the internet are never downloaded.
hints.odt: Word documents, ODT, RTF and text use LibreOffice; Markdown and HTML use Pandoc. Only images in the file's folder (or subfolders) are included; images from the internet are never downloaded.
hints.rtf: Word documents, ODT and text use LibreOffice; Markdown and HTML use Pandoc.
hints.txt: Text only, in UTF-8. Images and formatting are not kept.
hints.html: Uses Pandoc. Images are not included; their description takes their place.
hints.md: GitHub-style Markdown, with Pandoc. Images are not included; their description takes their place.

jsonToCsv.help: Accepts a list of objects (one column per key), of lists or of values. Nested values are written as JSON text. The protection puts ' before text that starts with =, +, - or @, so nothing runs when the file is opened in a spreadsheet.
